About the Practice

The VA New York Harbor Healthcare System is a set of hospitals and clinics run by the United States Department of Veterans Affairs in the New York City area, serving Veterans through 3 medical centers, 2 community-based outpatient clinics, and 2 mobile clinics. [11, 12] It is an innovative care center within the Veterans Integrated Service Network 2 (VISN 2) and provides a full range of health care services, conducts important medical research, and trains America's future health care providers through affiliations with universities. [11] The system offers comprehensive care guided by the needs of Veterans, their families, and caregivers. [3]
